XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Engine fuel supply

  • Component: Injector

  • Fault: Misfires with injector fault light (red) on

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P0204 (Injector, cylinder 4 – Generic fault)

  • Cause: Connection to the fourth cylinder’s injector compromised

• Action: Check the condition of the injector connections and, if necessary, replace or repair any defective or damaged ones

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the connection causing the fault was that of the injector for the first cylinder on the gearbox side; after its replacement, the fault was permanently resolved.

    Problems with these components are quite common on this engine.
